label: v0.9.0 — Mobile-style sub-menus (two auctions × Summary/Players/Lots/History/Tracker)
description: The hub now mirrors the mobile app: two top tabs (FA Auction · Expired Rookie), each broken into five sub-sections — Summary, Players, Lots, History, Tracker — instead of six flat tabs and one long FA scroll. A pill strip switches sub-sections and the body re-renders into a single container. Lots and History are split per auction (a player in the ERA-eligible pool → ERA, else FA). Summary leads with headline KPIs; the old Nominations tab folds into Lots (Open/Completed/All chips) and War Room into Tracker. Team Budgets columns are relabeled from the confusing 'Max Bid @27%/@35%' to 'Max Bid → 27-man / → 35-man' — 27 and 35 are roster sizes (§B1), not percentages; the value is the most you can spend on one player and still afford a legal roster filled to that size.

changes.summary: Restructured into two auction tabs × five sub-sections (Summary/Players/Lots/History/Tracker), mirroring the mobile app — replaces six flat tabs and the long FA scroll. Lots + History split per auction; Nominations→Lots, War Room→Tracker. Summary KPI strip added. Team Budgets columns relabeled to roster targets (27-man / 35-man) since 27/35 are §B1 roster sizes, not percentages.

FA Auction Pool tab activated (live lots + team budgets @27/@35 + roster needs + available pool from /acquisition-hub/free-agent-auction/live). ERA + FA tabs now honor the commish ERA/FAA switches via era_enabled/faa_enabled on /api/auction/lots — read-only 'not running' banner when off, live board when on, refreshed on the 30s cadence. Mirrors the mobile redesign so one set of switches controls both surfaces.

ERA-Eligible table redesign: dropped Age/Prior Owner/Rookie Slot/Rookie Salary columns; added 2023/2024/2025 PPG + 3-2-1 weighted avg; added live High Bid / High Bidder / Bids columns (LEFT JOIN ups_auction_lots). Fixed Origin classification — was returning Other for backfilled players; now resolves Rookie Draft / FA Auction / WW / MYM-Rookie via draftResults + transactions probe.

ERA nomination cadence switched from rolling 12h cooldown to ANCHORED 12h windows (6 AM / 6 PM ET). Opens Sat 6 PM ET, closes end of Tue 6 AM–6 PM ET window. Banner + per-franchise card show current window label + used_in_window.
